description: Find work email candidates for a person at a company: pass `full_name`, or `first_name` and/or `last_name`, together with the company `domain`. Each candidate has a validation verdict in `validity` — `valid`, `invalid`, `catchall`, `malformed` or another value; only `valid` is confirmed deliverable. `limit` caps the number of candidates (1–10). The result has the v3 answer in `data`, the credits charged for the call in `creditCost` and the `requestId` to quote to support. Fields with no value (null, empty lists, empty objects, empty text) are left out of `data`; for an optional section, a missing field means it found nothing or was not asked for. An answer is never longer than 24,000 bytes: if the full answer is longer, `data` keeps every field and every list that fits, and each list it leaves out is named in `more` with its number of items, its approximate size, its number of pages and a `cursor` for get_more. A list that is in `data` is always complete. Reading a page with get_more is a new lookup and is charged.

domain.description: Company domain to scope the lookup.

limit.description: Maximum number of email candidates to return.
